messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Alert: control-plane /auth-service 5xx spike detected (p95 latency 1.8s, error-rate 12%). Paging oncall group.

Sara Lin: I'm on it. seeing errors bubbling from org-lookup and billing cache calls in the control plane traces.

Miguel R: confirmed — in traces auth-service is timing out waiting on billing-lookup (500s from upstream) and that cascades to gateway returning 502/504.

Kevin O: any recent rollouts? I see a config rollout to org-lookup TTLs about 12m ago.

Alice P: @Kevin O yes we pushed org-lookup cache TTL lowering change to improve staleness window 15m ago (canary to 20% then global ~10m).

Nora (oncall): tagging: @Miguel R please grab traces + flame graphs. @Alice P can you pause/roll back the config if we suspect TTL causing stampede?

Miguel R: pulling traces now. initial hypothesis: TTL lowered -> cache miss storm -> billing/registry saw spike -> increased latency -> auth timeouts.

Sara Lin: Customer impact: API 5xxs for control-plane authenticated requests; degraded provisioned hosts and some Hosted API calls failing. CS reports multiple enterprise customers seeing errors.

Ops Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0931, priority P1, paged oncall.

Kevin O: I'm going to block the rollout in the control plane console and revert the config flag to previous TTL value. Pushing revert now.

Alice P: ack, reverting feature flag now. command: \n```\n$ redwood-ctl config set orglookup.ttl_seconds 180 --env=prod --strategy=revert\n```\n
Alice P: revert applied to canary. monitoring for error-rate.

Miguel R: traces show error-rate in canary pods dropped after revert within ~40s. Global revert in progress.

Sara Lin: Ops: start traffic shaping to direct Auth traffic to Dedicated pool fallback for 10m to buy time. Runbook step link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/controlplane-dep-failure

Kevin O: executing routing override: \n```\n$ rroute set --service auth --route fallback-dedicated --duration 600s --reason \"mitigation\"\n```\n
Nora (oncall): Confirming routing override in place. Observability: 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 3% over the last 2 mins. Latency p95 improving.

Sara Lin: Noting customer-visible: CS drafting status page message, comms lead pinged. Need list of affected orgs for targeted outreach.

Miguel R: grabbing failed request logs to map orgs. quick grep: top 10 org IDs by error volume attached to the incident.

Alice P: Global revert finished at +6m. Canary looked healthy then global completed.

Kevin O: Rolling back caused load dip but billing backend is still slow on some regions — hitting redis connection saturation. Opening a ticket with billing infra (assigning to Kevin).

Sara Lin: Can we enable KV-prefetch for org-lookup to reduce synchronous blocking? That'd be a short term patch.

Miguel R: Prefetch patch is low risk, will patch prod canary in 8m.

Ops Bot: Pager note: handoff scheduled in 50m to next oncall.

Nora (oncall): Current status: revert applied, routing override active, error-rate trending down to baseline. Mitigation actions: [revert config, routing override, prefetch patch queued]. Severity: P1 -> P2 candidate after 15m stable.

Alice P: CS update drafted: \"We observed elevated 5xx errors caused by a configuration change to org-lookup TTL that increased cache misses and downstream load on billing. We reverted the change and applied routing fallback; service is recovering. Targeted outreach to impacted customers underway.\" Waiting on legal for wording.

Kevin O: billing infra note: increasing redis connection pool temp on nodes in region-us-west to alleviate saturation. Patch rolled to 2/3 nodes.

Miguel R: Verified traces: end-to-end tail latency back to normal for 95% of requests. Remaining errors tied to a handful of orgs stuck in retry loops — will follow up with user-facing API teams to clear stuck state.

Sara Lin: Great. Plan: keep routing override for 20m, finish prefetch rollout, confirm redis pool stabilization, then remove override and monitor for 30m. If stable -> post-incident and RCA.

Nora (oncall): Handoff note for next oncall (in 45m): Revert completed, watch for regression from config redeploys, hold off any org-lookup TTL changes until RCA complete.

Alice P: :thumbsup: prepping postmortem template. I'll drop links and timeline in the incident ticket after we stabilize.

Kevin O: filing followups: RBAC check for canary gating, autoscale thresholds for billing caches, improve MLish anomaly detection on cache-miss storms.

Miguel R: prefetch canary looks good in 2m smoke. pushing global prefetch.

Ops Bot: Routing override removed at 5979999400 by Kevin O.

Nora (oncall): Observability: 5xx stable at baseline 0.6% for the last 5 minutes. Downgrading severity to P2 and preparing for incident close.

Sara Lin: Thanks team. Please add any timeline notes and signal metrics to INC-2026-0931. I'll own customer comms post-legal.

Miguel R: follow-ups added to ticket.

Alice P: postmortem draft in INC-2026-0931/pm-draft, will circulate for review.

Nora (oncall): handing off to next oncall @Miguel R in 30m. Leaving watch and will be reachable. :eyes:
